pr_title: [Feature] Add RoPE switch support to MLA preprocess
source_quote: In `ProcessRawQ()`, there are no vector (V) instructions executed. Routing the pipeline synchronization through the V unit (`MTE2 -> V` and then `V -> MTE3`) is redundant and introduces unnecessary latency. Synchronizing `MTE2 -> MTE3` directly using `EVENT_ID1` avoids involving the V unit entirely. Additionally, placing the scalar calculations for `outQOffset` and `outQOffset2` between `SET_FLAG` and `WAIT_FLAG` allows them to run in parallel with the MTE2 data copy, further optimizing performance.

rule.description: 当流水线同步路径中转的单元（如 V）在该代码段无任何指令执行时，应使用直连同步（如 `MTE2 -> MTE3`）而非经中转单元（`MTE2 -> V -> MTE3`），并将可并行的标量计算置于 SET_FLAG/WAIT_FLAG 之间隐藏延迟。
checkpoints: 检查 `SET_FLAG`/`WAIT_FLAG` 链是否经过无指令执行的单元中转
若起止单元间可直连，移除中转并合并为单条直连同步
将独立标量计算置于 SET_FLAG 与 WAIT_FLAG 之间以重叠执行
